verdicts.rationale: Raw request evidence (output_weaviate_007.log) shows POST /schema with explicit 'distance': null payload. API returned HTTP 200 with 'distance': 'cosine' in response, confirming silent type coercion from null to default value. Source code analysis (OptionalStringFromMap in entities/vectorindex/common/config.go lines 103-106) proves the root cause: when value is null, the type assertion value.(string) fails, function returns nil without calling the setter, leaving the default value from SetDefaults() intact. This violates the principle that explicit user input (null) should be validated, not silently coerced. The bug matches developer cognition pattern BS-004 (Parameter Validation Issues in Request Parsing) with high confidence.
